recommendation_summary: Wrap the cron job on edna so it always sends an email, through the user's existing email path, whenever the sync exits non-zero or leaves no success marker.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know by morning if nightly-sync fails, without reading logs. Without that, a startup crash stays silent.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Docker for the job, Pieter Levels style dashboard.
labels.Bottleneck: The job crashes before its summary email, so failure produces no signal off edna.
labels.Checked myself: From what you told me: cron on edna at 03:00, email only on finish, 4 startup crashes on expired token, no other alert.

note: The reply recommends a single failure-email wrapper and explicitly rejects the Synology central log.
